reviews.text:
The use of AI for this app is unnecessary and fundamentally anti-Christian. Widget is very easy! I love the verses and that sometimes I see 2-3 a day. HOWEVER…there is a “daily bible art tab” I just discovered which is just full of AI generated BS. Are we not called to be guardians of our planet? To consider and love our neighbor? AI facilities are a direct threat to these aspirations. They consume unsustainable amounts of water and threaten the quality of life of those unfortunate enough to live near them. And more often than not, they are built on cheap land near lower income families. I’m deleting the app immediately, which is a shame because I really liked it so far.

What’s the point in cherishing the gifts and talents He gave us if we squander them in favor of instant gratification?

reviews.text: Good content, tricky on the renewal. The content is good for sure, but I clicked on the trial for seven days and indicated that I wanted to be notified before the subscription for the year would start as the app asked if I wanted to. I thought they would at least do what other apps who indicate that question would do in alerting me through notifications. The app notifies me three times a day about new Bible verses and such but somehow someway sarcasm intended, they didn't notify me about the subscription. Then they banked me for the full year. So yes, I like the content, but I would've assumed that they would at least do what they said and indicated like they do with everything else whether I wanted to renew or not. That's called being truthful. I will never renew again. there are other apps out there that offer the same or similar and it's unfortunate that they have deceptive business practices to retain customers.
